import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final FastReader sc = new FastReader();

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        char[] a = sc.next().toCharArray();
        if (a.length == 1 && a[0] == '0') {
            System.out.println(1);
            return;
        }
        if (a[0] == '0') {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        if (a.length == 1 && (a[0] == 'X' || a[0] == '_')) {
            System.out.println(1);
            return;
        }

        long[][][] dp = new long[a.length + 1][25][11];
        for (long[][] plane : dp) {
            for (long[] row : plane) {
                Arrays.fill(row, -1);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dfs(a, 0, 0, 10, dp));
    }

    static long dfs(char[] a, int i, int rem, int x, long[][][] dp) {
        if (i == a.length) {
            return rem == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        }
        if (dp[i][rem][x] != -1) {
            return dp[i][rem][x];
        }
        long ans = 0;
        if (a[i] == '_') {
            for (int d = 0; d < 10; d++) {
                if (i == 0 && d == 0) continue;
                ans += dfs(a, i + 1, (rem * 10 + d) % 25, x, dp);
            }
        } else if (a[i] == 'X') {
            if (x != 10) {
                ans += dfs(a, i + 1, (rem * 10 + x) % 25, x, dp);
            } else {
                for (int d = 0; d < 10; d++) {
                    if (i == 0 && d == 0) continue;
                    ans += dfs(a, i + 1, (rem * 10 + d) % 25, d, dp);
                }
            }
        } else {
            ans += dfs(a, i + 1, (rem * 10 + a[i] - '0') % 25, x, dp);
        }
        return dp[i][rem][x] = ans;
    }

    static class FastReader {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        FastReader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }
    }
}

import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final FastReader sc = new FastReader();

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        char[] a = sc.next().toCharArray();
        if (a.length == 1 && a[0] == '0') {
            System.out.println(1);
            return;
        }
        if (a[0] == '0') {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        if (a.length == 1 && (a[0] == 'X' || a[0] == '_')) {
            System.out.println(1);
            return;
        }

        boolean hasX = false;
        for (char c : a) {
            if (c == 'X') {
                hasX = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!hasX) {
            System.out.println(countFixed(a, 0));
        } else {
            long total = 0;
            for (int d = 0; d < 10; d++) {
                if (a[0] == 'X' && d == 0) continue;
                total += countFixed(a, d);
            }
            System.out.println(total);
        }
    }

    static long countFixed(char[] a, int fixedX) {
        long[][] memo = new long[a.length + 1][25];
        for (long[] row : memo) {
            Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        }
        return dfsFixed(a, 0, 0, fixedX, memo);
    }

    static long dfsFixed(char[] a, int i, int rem, int fixedX, long[][] memo) {
        if (i == a.length) {
            return rem == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        }
        if (memo[i][rem] != -1) {
            return memo[i][rem];
        }

        long ans = 0;
        if (a[i] == '_') {
            for (int d = 0; d < 10; d++) {
                if (i == 0 && d == 0) continue;
                ans += dfsFixed(a, i + 1, (rem * 10 + d) % 25, fixedX, memo);
            }
        } else if (a[i] == 'X') {
            if (i == 0 && fixedX == 0) {
                ans = 0;
            } else {
                ans += dfsFixed(a, i + 1, (rem * 10 + fixedX) % 25, fixedX, memo);
            }
        } else {
            ans += dfsFixed(a, i + 1, (rem * 10 + a[i] - '0') % 25, fixedX, memo);
        }

        return memo[i][rem] = ans;
    }

    static class FastReader {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        FastReader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }
    }
}
